projectContext: Sprint 19 continues test coverage improvements, targeting the compilation module (GapAnalyzer, TopicBroadener, CompilationTimelineBuilder), stage checkpoint serialization edge cases, and test infrastructure enhancements. Previous testing sprints (13-17) established coverage for conftest fixtures, cache systems, and scoring functions. Sprint 18 completed comprehensive scoring function tests (temporal coherence, transcript quality, semantic coherence, pool normalization, confidence histogram). This sprint addresses ~300 LOC of untested compilation logic and test reliability patterns that affect CI/CD pipeline stability.
